item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:50 HKT 20/Aug/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of a broad trough of low pressure, there will be showers and thunderstorms over the coast of Guangdong today and tomorrow. With the anticyclone aloft strengthening, the weather will be fine and very hot over southern China early next week. An upper-air disturbance is expected to bring unsettled weather to the region in the middle and latter parts of next week.

Date/Month: 20/08 (Saturday)
Wind: Southeast force 4 to 5, force 6 offshore and on high ground at first.
Weather: Cloudy with showers and a few thunderstorms.
Temp range: 26 - 30 C
R.H. range: 75 - 95 per Cent
PSR: Medium High
